text: The one trigger I ratify is trade_above:bar_high (D): buy stop 1 tick over yesterday's high, trailed to each new prior-day high (C27), ACT_NOW. reclaim:ma_20 waits for a dip; in my position system the break is the signal and every step already passes: structure_shift ABOVE_STRUCTURE, cmf 0.59 (COM proxy), elder_pattern SUSTAINED (TIF proxy), ret_63d 27.22, rs_rank_pct 86.42. It also answers livermore's point that reclaim:ma_20 buys the reaction. Wrong on a daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d). My objection clears when the ticket carries trade_above:bar_high.
